reason: The user is requesting multiple actions on one order (return/exchange a luggage set, exchange a skateboard to a different length/custom design, and return hiking boots). Per policy, exchange/modify order tools can only be called once per order and must collect all changed items into a list; also only same-product, different-option exchanges are allowed. The skateboard request ('34 inches' and 'custom design') may involve different product types or nonstandard options, and the luggage request is phrased as return plus obtaining an identical item in red, all increasing the likelihood the agent cannot fulfill the request exactly and it ends unsuccessfully.
